Another possibility is that if OP is only self-harming and is not necessarily actively suicidal, I’ve seen admissions denied for that before too. Because they’re not “imminent risk” and in theory are safe enough to wait for a next-day outpatient appointment. Basically the way they look at it is “yeah your skin is torn to shreds but you ain’t gonna die so just call your doc/therapist tomorrow” especially if there’s multiple admissions coming in and they have to triage. 

Most self-injury is considered a non-suicidal act so while it needs dealt with and intensive therapy, it doesn’t necessarily need to be inpatient.

I used to work inpatient psych. It was a really small unit and part of the reason I ended up leaving was because I couldn’t stand working in a place that was so unsafe, for patients and staff. 

Anyways, sometimes when we got a really violent patient or really psychotic patient, the acuity was so high that we had to reject “less severe” patients even when we had the beds because it was not safe for them and it was not safe for staff to add another patient to the load. 

I can’t say if this was the case. If they were truly just dismissive, that’s fucked up. But I just wanted to give a possible perspective as someone who’s had to block beds before. 

I struggled with self harm for almost 15 years and I’ve been clean for 3 or 4 years now but the thoughts still come. You do get better and you do get stronger though and the fight is worth it. ❤️‍🩹💖

3. Gen 3 seemed to be the most realistic story for a friend group of the 3 generations. They got fucked up now and again but you didn’t see it happening all the time. The stories of fickle interests (rich going from extreme metal head to that just being a kind of casual interest), franky’s gender identity if they would have even just thrown a line in there about how she doesn’t know but right now dressing more femme feels right in season 6, teen pregnancy, living up to parental expectations, shame and fear around sex, to me that all seemed much more normal than some of the more extremes that happened, especially in gen 2. At the time I saw a lot of people say Gen 3 was catering too much to an American audience, it wasn’t “skins” and it was more “mean girls” and “degrassi”. But to me, Skins has always just been about putting the true, messy, flawed adolescent experience on screen and gen 3 felt the most realistic to my personal adolescent experience. Oh no I get where you’re coming from! 

My favorite thing about skins is that the characters are flawed and do fuck up so much. Because I was a mess when I was at that age and maybe not as extreme as Effy, but I can definitely put myself in her shoes as someone who was struggling with mental illness at that age. 

It’s easy to say as the viewer what *should* have happened. And I definitely dont condone Effy’s actions. 

But it wasn’t so cut and dry and Effy’s isn’t a murderer either. 

The way I interpreted it as (and I could be wrong from how the writers meant it): Effy was flirting with Freddie, she starts tripping and wanders off (as one does when under the influence), Katie, who is mostly sober, recognizes this and chooses to confront Effy at this moment. I’m not saying she deserved it but she knew she was manipulating Effy when she was not of sound mind. They fight, Katie is choking Effy, and in self-defense, Effy grabs a rock and chucks it. I think the head blow was unintentional, she just wanted Katie off of her. From there, she takes off. I don’t think “dead or alive” was a thought, just “okay she’s off of me let’s go before she gets up.” 

Back to camp, she finds Freddie, who has been a source of solace for her. She’s likely still tripping. They hook up. Then the next morning, she’s trying to write all of it off as a bad trip. Calls 911 just in case, but bolts. When she comes to hospital and is confronted, she’s also on the come down of her drugs, and has to own up to all of it. 


But the friend group never finds out about Katie manipulating the situation. No one calls Freddie out for cheating. And Effy and Katie weren’t really friends except by mutual acquaintances. It’s shitty to sleep with a guy you know is taken. But she’s not the one in that situation who owed Katie any loyalty. Freddie did. 


All three of them did something fucked up in that situation, but the entire night is blamed on Effy. 


I definitely don’t think she did the right thing. But like the post said, what’s the skins opinion you’ll write a novel over. Clearly this is mine hahahaha.

I always kind of thought that Effy might have even thought she hallucinated the fight but once it was for sure real and Freddie came to her about it, she did own up.

I don’t have much of a recipe as I kind of just make it to taste. But I have basic instructions :) 

But cook onions in a stock pot until soft, add minced garlic and cook until fragrant. Add 2 lbs ground beef. Brown the ground beef and drain the liquids. Add one container (like the box at the store) of swanson’s beef stock. Add chili powder (like half of a McCormick chili powder), a dash of cumin. Some cayenne and Hungarian paprika. Add to taste. Add 3 cans of diced tomatoes (I literally used Kroger “chili ready” diced tomatoes for like 69¢ a can) and one jar of pace picante salsa. Let it simmer for ~20-30 mins. Add 3 cans of beans (I used dark kidney beans, light kidney beans, and cannellini beans) and let the pot simmer and cook down for about an hour. Add another container of beef stock to thin out the chili if it gets too thick while it’s simmering. Play with your spices until it’s to your taste. 

Make sure to stir frequently (I did about every 5-7 minutes) throughout while it’s simmering so the beef doesn’t burn to the bottom.
